dashboard.chart_hint: Green = profit, red = loss. Hover a bar for details.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Kabul Cargo branches. A new branch gets its 172 field settings automatically.
branches.name: Name
branches.code_hint: Capital letters, max 10; cannot be changed later.
branches.code_readonly: The code cannot be changed after creation.
branches.created: Branch “{{name}}” added — {{n}} fields set up automatically
branches.delete_confirm_message: Its field settings are deleted too. A branch with users or transactions cannot be deleted.
branches.seed_notice: After saving, 172 field settings (4 trade types × 43 fields) are created automatically.
branches.code_invalid: Code: capital letters and digits only, max 10.

users.title: Users
users.description: Super admins and branch managers. Users are never deleted — deactivate them so history stays.
users.change_password_hint: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.branch_not_needed: A super admin is not tied to a branch.
users.unlock_confirm: This account is locked after too many failed logins. Unlocking lets the user sign in again right away.
users.deactivate_confirm: The user can no longer sign in. Their history stays; you can reactivate them any time.
users.activate_confirm: The user will be able to sign in again.
users.password_rules: At least 8 characters, not only digits, not like the username, not a common password.
users.branch_required: A branch manager needs a branch
users.password_required: A new user needs a password

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: Daily rates: how many AFN one unit is worth. Without today’s USD rate, transactions cannot be recorded.
rates.rate_hint: Up to 8 decimals. Dari digits are fine.
rates.today_missing: Today’s rate is not entered yet. Recording transactions is blocked.
rates.today_missing_body: Until today’s USD rate is entered, no new transaction, hawala or office expense can be saved.
rates.future_rejected: Rates cannot be entered for a future date.
rates.immutable_note: Rates cannot be edited. If one is wrong, delete it and enter it again.
rates.delete_confirm: Records already saved with this rate keep their own copy. Deleting only affects later reads for that date.
rates.rate_invalid: A positive number with at most 8 decimals
rates.today_only_note: A branch manager can enter today’s rate only; a saved rate cannot be edited or deleted.

statement_lines.title: Statement lines
statement_lines.description: Each line links one transaction amount, office expense / hawala source, or office-income category to one line of the income statement. Lines of new types are made automatically. Order follows “sort order”.
statement_lines.code_hint: Capitals, digits and _, starting with a letter. Cannot be changed later.
statement_lines.inline_hint: Click to edit; leaving the cell saves.
statement_lines.code_invalid: Capitals, digits and _ only, starting with a letter.
statement_lines.revenue_rule: The revenue section takes revenue types only; office income goes under “Other income”.

traders.title: Traders
traders.description: Traders and customers who pay for the trucks. Every branch sees the same list.
traders.name: Trader / customer name
traders.search_placeholder: Search name, company, phone or ID…
traders.delete_confirm: A trader with transactions cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.
traders.deactivate_confirm: Inactive traders are hidden in new transaction forms. Their past transactions are untouched.
traders.activate_confirm: The trader shows up in new forms again.

transport_companies.title: Transport companies
transport_companies.description: Companies whose trucks carry the cargo. Every branch sees the same list.
transport_companies.name: Company name
transport_companies.delete_confirm: A company with transactions cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
transport_companies.deactivate_confirm: Inactive companies are hidden in new transaction forms. Past transactions are untouched.
transport_companies.activate_confirm: The company shows up in new forms again.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: One row per truck. The only revenue is the customer payment; every other amount is an expense.
transactions.serial_search: Search serial, plate, driver or trader…
transactions.not_found: This transaction was not found or is not in your branch.
transactions.discard: Leave the form? Unsaved changes are lost.
transactions.rate_hint: Rate on the transaction day: {{rate}} AFN
transactions.rate_hint_missing: No {{currency}} rate entered for this day.
transactions.rate_required: A rate is required for any currency other than AFN
transactions.rate_invalid: A positive rate, at most 8 decimals
transactions.draft_restored: What you typed earlier has been restored.
transactions.delete_message: The transaction and all its documents are deleted for good. The change history stays.

summary.title: Row summary
summary.usd_unknown: USD equivalent is not computed yet for currencies other than USD
summary.note: Revenue = the customer payment and every type the super admin marked as revenue; all other amounts are expenses.
summary.missing_today_rate: Today’s USD rate is not entered
summary.missing_today_rate_body: The transaction cannot be saved until today’s rate is entered. What you typed is kept and comes back after you enter the rate.

detail.title: Transaction
detail.usd_rate_line: USD rate of the transaction date: {{rate}} AFN

documents.title: Documents
documents.drop_hint: Drag and drop files here, or choose them
documents.limits: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP — up to {{mb}} MB each
documents.too_large: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
documents.bad_type: File type not allowed. Only PDF, JPG, PNG and WEBP.
documents.content_mismatch: The file content does not match its type. The file is broken or forged.
documents.delete_message: The file is deleted for good.
documents.none_required: No documents are required for this trade type at this branch.
documents.missing_never_blocks: A missing document is only a warning; it never blocks saving.
documents.number_hint_empty: The transaction’s {{field}} is empty; it will be filled from this document.
documents.number_filled: The transaction’s {{field}} was filled from the document: {{value}}
documents.mismatch: This document’s number differs from the transaction’s {{field}} ({{value}}). Neither was changed.
documents.register_description: All customs and transport documents; search by document number.
documents.search_placeholder: Search: document number, transaction serial or plate
documents.missing_hint: Transactions still lacking a document their branch requires (all dates).
documents.missing_empty: Every transaction has its required documents.

finance.totals_title: Totals of all records in this filter
finance.unconverted: {{n}} records have no rate; the AFN and USD totals are incomplete.
finance.rate_will_use: This day's {{currency}} rate, stored with the record: {{rate}}
finance.rate_kept: This record's stored rate: {{rate}} — later rate changes do not alter it.
finance.rate_missing_day: No {{currency}} rate for this date; the report uses the latest rate before it.
finance.no_rate_today: Today's USD rate is missing; new records cannot be saved.
finance.rate_missing_body: Nothing new is saved until today's rate is entered. Enter it and the form is saved again automatically.
finance.not_found: This record was not found or is not in your branch.

hawala.title: Hawala
hawala.description: Money sent by hawala. Only the hawala fee is an expense; the amount itself is money moved.
hawala.delete_confirm: This hawala is deleted for good and leaves the income statement too.

office_expenses.title: Office expenses
office_expenses.description: The branch office's running costs. Salaries appear separately in the income statement.
office_expenses.delete_confirm: This expense is deleted for good and leaves the income statement too.

reports.title: Income statement
reports.description: Income statement in the IAS 1 layout: revenue, direct costs, gross profit, operating expenses, other expenses, other income (office income), net profit. Click a line to see its records.
reports.drill_hint: Click a line to open the records that make up the amount (same period and branch).

document_types.title: Document types
document_types.description: Documents uploaded at the branches (T1, CMR, declaration, …).
document_types.new_hint: A new type is added to every branch’s requirement grid (not required until you tick it).
document_types.code_hint: Capital letters, digits and _ — e.g. T1 or CMR
document_types.code_readonly: The code cannot change once saved.
document_types.code_invalid: Use capital letters, digits and _ only (e.g. T1).
document_types.number_field_hint: The document number is compared with this field; an empty field is filled.
document_types.delete_message: A type with uploaded documents cannot be deleted; make it inactive instead.

requirements.title: Required documents
requirements.description: Per branch, choose which documents each trade type needs. Transactions without them show as «missing documents» (warning only).

field_settings.title: Field settings
field_settings.description: For each branch and trade type, choose which fields the transaction form shows, which are required, and in what order. Changes only show in the preview until you save.
field_settings.locked: This field is locked and always required: without serial, date, customer payment, currency and rate a transaction cannot be saved or calculated.
field_settings.hidden_warning: {{count}} transaction(s) of this branch and type have a value in this field. The data is kept and still shown on the transaction detail page; only the form hides the field.
field_settings.save_first: Save or cancel your changes first
field_settings.leave_message: {{count}} change(s) are not saved yet. If you leave, they are lost.
field_settings.preview_hint: The new-transaction form as the branch manager of “{{scope}}” will see it (with unsaved changes). View only.
field_settings.copy_from_hint: The visibility and order of every field of “{{scope}}” is replaced with the source settings.
field_settings.same_source: Source and target are the same.
field_settings.copy_all_message: The settings of “{{scope}}” are written to {{type}} of every other branch ({{count}}). Their current settings are lost.
field_settings.reset_message: The visibility and order of every field of “{{scope}}” go back to the system defaults.
field_settings.money_note: Revenue and expense fields (customer payment, khak-puli, tariff …) are set in one place only — names, order, required / optional / hidden, and revenue or expense:

office_income.title: Office income
office_income.description: The office’s own income (commission, storage …), not tied to one truck. Shown under “Other income” in the income statement.
office_income.no_results: No office income in this period
office_income.delete_confirm: This income is deleted for good and leaves the income statement too.

money_settings.title: Revenue & expenses
money_settings.description: Every money type of the transaction form: names, order, revenue or expense, statement section, active, and required / optional / hidden per branch × trade type. Changes show only in the preview until you save.
money_settings.revenue_rule: An amount is revenue only if its type is revenue. The customer payment is always revenue and required. Balance = total revenue − total expenses.
money_settings.expense_rule: Every expense is deducted from the balance and shown in its chosen statement section.
money_settings.categories_rule: Each category is one “Other income” line of the income statement. A category with income cannot be deleted; deactivate it.
money_settings.add_revenue_hint: The type is added as optional to the form’s revenue section in every branch and trade type, with its own revenue line in the statement.
money_settings.add_expense_hint: The type is added as optional to the form’s expense section in every branch and trade type, with its own line in the chosen statement section.
money_settings.name: Name
money_settings.names_hint: The new name shows in the form, detail, print, Excel and the statement line. Amounts do not change.
money_settings.locked: The customer payment is always revenue, active and required.
money_settings.scope_hint: Required / optional / hidden is saved for “{{scope}}” — or, with the two switches, for every branch and / or every trade type. Names, order and revenue / expense are the same everywhere.
money_settings.kind_to_revenue: From now on this type’s amounts are added to the balance (revenue) and shown under revenue. Only possible while no transaction holds an amount of it. Applied when you save.
money_settings.kind_to_expense: From now on this type’s amounts are deducted from the balance (expense) and shown under direct costs (changeable). Only possible while no transaction holds an amount of it. Applied when you save.
money_settings.kind_blocked: {{n}} transactions hold an amount of this type; its kind changes only while it has none.
money_settings.hide_message: {{count}} transactions of this branch and trade type hold an amount in this field. Amounts are kept in the detail, print and reports; only the form stops showing it.
money_settings.deactivate_message: {{count}} transactions hold an amount of this type. Those amounts stay in reports, detail and Excel; it just leaves every form.
money_settings.delete_message: This type has no amounts; it is removed from every form and from the income statement.
money_settings.delete_blocked: A type with amounts cannot be deleted; deactivate it.
money_settings.preview: Preview of the revenue and expense sections
money_settings.category_delete_message: Its “Other income” line is removed from the income statement too.
money_settings.category_delete_blocked: A category with incomes cannot be deleted; deactivate it.
